notice.failed: The AI check failed: {{error}} Rate your sentence yourself.

spoken.twoSteps: Two AI steps check your answer (transcription, then correction): this can take up to about 90 seconds. Your recording stays on this computer.
spoken.skip: Skip the check and rate myself
spoken.silence: No speech was heard in your recording. Compare with the example answer and rate yourself.
spoken.unavailable: Your recording could not be transcribed: {{reason}}. Compare with the example answer and rate yourself.
spoken.correctionFailed: The correction is not available: {{reason}}. What was heard is shown above; rate yourself.

notice.skipped: Check skipped. Rate your answer yourself.
notice.failed: The check failed: {{error}} Rate your answer yourself.

queue.title: Deck queue
queue.intro: New terms come from your decks in this order, within the daily quota. Due reviews always come first.
queue.orderHelp: Decks with a deadline to come are placed first, by date, and cannot be moved by hand. Move the other decks up or down to choose which one supplies new terms next.
queue.pauseNote: Pausing a deck or marking it done stops its new terms only: the cards already created keep being reviewed.
queue.allDone: Every deck is done. Reopen one below, or import a new list.
queue.pace_one: {{remaining}} terms left to discover in {{days}} days: {{count}} new term a day is needed.
queue.pace_other: {{remaining}} terms left to discover in {{days}} days: {{count}} new terms a day are needed.

announce.movedUp: “{{deck}}” moved up: it is now number {{position}}.
announce.movedDown: “{{deck}}” moved down: it is now number {{position}}.

queue.reloaded: Nothing was changed; the list was loaded again.

correction.yourText: Your text, with the errors marked
correction.naturalnessIntro: These parts are grammatical. A native speaker would probably say them differently. They are not errors and are not logged.
correction.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it yourself.
correction.targetDisagreement: The AI and the text search disagree about whether this term was used.
correction.proposedTitle: The AI proposed a new category
correction.yourTurns: Your turns, with the errors marked
correction.contextSent: Analysed with the other speaker's context: the end of the turn before each of yours was read.
correction.contextNotSent: Analysed without the other speaker's context.
correction.noErrorsTurns: No errors found in your turns.
correction.noConnectors: No connector was found in this speech.
correction.heardNote: The correction is about what was heard: a mistake the recogniser smoothed over is not reported, and a misheard word may be.

writing.title: Writing
writing.intro: Write a short paragraph in English. The AI corrects it, marks each error and adds it to your error log.

topics.title: Choose a topic
topics.intro: Three suggestions for today, or write on your own topic.

text.label: Your text
text.tooLong: This text has {{chars}} characters and the limit is {{max}}. Shorten it before sending.

writing.submitHint: Your text is saved first, then corrected. The correction takes a few seconds, sometimes up to a minute.

detail.title: Your text and its correction
detail.checkingHint: The AI is checking your text. It is saved already; you can wait here.
detail.notCorrected: Your text is saved but was not corrected.
detail.notCorrectedIncomplete: Your text is saved but was not corrected: the AI's answer could not be used.
detail.notCorrectedReason: Your text is saved but was not corrected: {{reason}}.

history.title: My texts
history.empty: No text yet. Write the first one.
history.mixed: This list also holds the personal sentences of the discovery and the sentences you wrote in reviews: the topic column tells them apart.

transcripts.title: Conversation transcript
transcripts.intro: Paste a conversation, for example a voice session with ChatGPT, and say which turns are yours. Only your own errors are analysed, turn by turn, and added to your error log.

paste.label: The conversation
paste.tooLong: This text has {{chars}} characters and the limit is {{max}}. Shorten it before the preview.
paste.stale: The text changed since the preview. Preview it again.

picker.labelsHint: Choose the speaker label that is you.
picker.modesHint: This text has no speaker labels, so each paragraph is a turn. Say which turns are yours.
picker.single: “{{label}}” has only one turn. A line that starts with a word and a colon, such as “Note:”, opens a new turn. If “{{label}}” is not a speaker, remove the colon in your text and preview it again.

problems.empty_text: There is no text to analyse.
problems.too_large: The text is too long: at most 60,000 pasted characters, and at most 6,000 characters in your own turns.
problems.no_speaker_labels: No speaker labels were found: each paragraph is a turn. Say which turns are yours.
problems.unlabelled_text: Some text comes before the first speaker label. It is kept as a turn that is not yours.
problems.empty_turn: This turn is empty and is ignored.
problems.unknown_label: The speaker label you chose is not in the text.
problems.no_user_turns: None of the turns is yours with this choice.

reasons.future_date: The date of the conversation is in the future.

meta.title: Details (optional)
meta.dateFuture: This date is in the future.

privacy.title: Before you save
privacy.body: Only your turns are saved. To analyse them, your turns and the end of the other speaker's turn that comes before each of them ({{chars}} characters at most) are sent to the AI provider. On a free plan, this content may be used to improve its models.

transcripts.saveHint: Preview the text and choose your turns first; then you can save.

detail.title: Your conversation and its analysis
detail.analysingHint: A long conversation needs several AI calls and can take a few minutes. Your turns are saved: you can wait here.
detail.notAnalysed: Your turns are saved but were not analysed.
detail.notAnalysedIncomplete: Your turns are saved but were not analysed: the AI's answer could not be used.
detail.notAnalysedReason: Your turns are saved but were not analysed: {{reason}}.
detail.noMemory: The conversation you pasted is not kept after a reload, so the other speaker's turns cannot be sent as context. Analyse your turns without that context, or paste the conversation again.
detail.withoutContext: Analyse without the other speaker's context

history.title: My conversations
history.intro: The conversations you recorded, newest first.
history.empty: No conversation yet. Paste the first one.

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.intro: Every mistake found in your texts, reviews and drills. Open one to correct it, link it to a term or delete it.

list.empty: Your error log is empty. Write a text, answer a review or add an error by hand.

detail.title: An error in your log
detail.noOriginal: No sentence was stored with this error.
detail.wrongNotFound: The incorrect form could not be located in the sentence.
detail.openText: Open the text it comes from
detail.explanationNote: Changing the explanation removes its French translation.
detail.unchanged: Nothing to save: no field has changed.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this error from your log? The statistics will no longer count it.
detail.openDrill: Open the drill it comes from

manual.title: Add an error
manual.intro: Note a mistake you noticed yourself. It joins your log like the others.
manual.prefilled: Filled in from your shadowing: read it, change what is wrong, then add it. Nothing is saved until you do.
manual.original: The sentence where you made it (optional)
manual.wrongNotInOriginal: The incorrect form must appear in the sentence.
manual.sameAsCorrection: The correction must differ from the incorrect form.

categories.title: Error categories
categories.intro: The taxonomy your errors are sorted in. Add your own subcategories, and decide on those the AI proposes.
categories.proposalsIntro: The AI suggests these subcategories. Accept one to use it, or reject it: its errors move to the parent category.
categories.rejectConfirm: Rejecting “{{label}}” moves its errors to the parent category.
categories.rejected_one: “{{label}}” rejected. {{count}} error moved to the parent category.
categories.rejected_other: “{{label}}” rejected. {{count}} errors moved to the parent category.
categories.rejectedNone: “{{label}}” rejected. No error had to move.
categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and “_”, 2 to 41 characters, starting with a letter.
categories.slugInvalid: The code name must follow the rule below the field.

drills.title: Targeted drills
drills.intro: Short exercises on one error category, written by the AI from your own mistakes. A wrong answer is added to your error log.

form.title: New drill
form.preparingHint: The AI is writing them; this takes a few seconds.
form.noCategories: No category can be practised yet.
form.fromSession: This drill is part of today's session.
form.unavailable: The drill could not be created: {{reason}}. Nothing was saved; you can try again.
form.incomplete: The AI's answer could not be used. Nothing was saved; you can try again.

list.title: Your drills
list.empty: No drill yet. Create the first one above.
list.emptyFiltered: No drill in this category yet.

result.label: Result
result.errorNote: The correction is exact. If you think your answer was correct, you can delete this error from your log.

reasons.level: Choose a more precise category (level 2 or more).
reasons.pronunciation: Pronunciation cannot be practised in writing.
reasons.proposed: This category is only proposed: accept it in the categories page first.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation
pronunciation.privacy: This sends the recording to Microsoft Azure. It uses part of the free monthly allowance.
pronunciation.estimate: An automatic estimate, not a teacher's judgment. Scores from 0 to 100; a low score on a word is a hint to listen again, not a verdict.
pronunciation.unavailable: The assessment could not be done: {{reason}}. Nothing was stored; you can try again.
pronunciation.incomplete: Azure answered in an unexpected way. Nothing was stored; you can try again.
pronunciation.silence: Azure heard no speech in this recording, so there is nothing to score.

reasons.no_target: This shadowing has no sentence to compare with.
reasons.not_configured: Azure is not configured in the settings.
reasons.unsupported_format: This recording is not in a format Azure reads (it was recorded before the assessment was turned on).
reasons.too_long: The recording is longer than 30 seconds.

pronunciation.wordsHint: Each word shows its score and, when there is one, the kind of problem. Lower scores are marked in words, not only by colour.

consolidation.title: Consolidation
consolidation.intro: When most of a deck is solid, use its terms in a real talk, speech or interview answer. The terms you use correctly become active.

decks.noneReady: No deck is ready yet. Keep reviewing: a deck becomes ready when enough of its productive cards are stable.
decks.readyLine: {{ratio}} of its productive cards are stable (at least {{days}} days; {{threshold}} needed). {{count}} terms can be used.

reasons.excluded_kind: This kind of deck is not used for consolidation.
reasons.task_open: A task is already open for this deck.
reasons.no_productive_cards: It has no productive card yet.
reasons.below_ratio: {{ratio}} of its productive cards are stable (at least {{days}} days); {{threshold}} needed.
reasons.not_enough_candidates_one: Only {{count}} term is usable so far: at least 8 are needed.
reasons.not_enough_candidates_other: Only {{count}} terms are usable so far: at least 8 are needed.

create.wait: The AI is writing the topic and the structure (a few seconds). If it cannot, a template is used.

task.title: Consolidation task
task.templateNote: This task was made from a template, not by the AI, so the topic is generic.

confirm.completed: Mark this task as completed? It will take no new production.
confirm.dismissed: Dismiss this task? It will take no new production, and the deck can get another task.

task.templateReason: The AI could not make it: {{reason}}

produce.title: Your production
produce.intro: Write or record your talk using the terms above, without looking anything up. The terms are checked after you send it.

write.label: Your text
write.hint: Your text is saved first, then corrected on the next page. Up to 40 sentences.

speak.hint: Record between 20 seconds and 4 minutes. The task text is not sent to the speech recogniser.

export.title: Export
export.intro: A Markdown file with the topic, the structure and the terms, to practise afterwards with ChatGPT voice.

attempt.title: Consolidation attempt
attempt.recordAgain: Back to the task to record again
attempt.notCorrected: This attempt is not corrected yet. No term has changed.
attempt.notCorrectedIncomplete: The AI answered, but its answer was incomplete. Nothing changed; try again.
attempt.notCorrectedReason: The AI could not correct it: {{reason}}. Nothing changed; try again later.
attempt.finishHint: Nothing completes a task by itself. Complete it when you are happy with your production, or make another attempt.

summary.title: The terms of the task
summary.counts: {{total}} terms: {{correct}} used correctly, {{wrong}} used wrongly, {{absent}} not used.

hints.wrong: The mistake is in your error log and the review card of each term was reinforced.
hints.absent: Nothing changes for these terms. Use them in the next attempt.
hints.unknown: The AI did not judge these terms.

summary.effect: {{active}} term(s) became active and {{reinforced}} review card(s) were reinforced.

curriculum.title: General English tracks
curriculum.intro: Learn common English beyond your own lists: the most frequent words, academic words and speaking scenarios. Everything here ends up in your library and your reviews.
curriculum.wordlistMissing: The word list file is missing from this installation, so this track cannot be started.
curriculum.deckLink: Open the deck of this track
curriculum.licence: NGSL / NAWL 1.2, Browne, Culligan & Phillips, CC BY-SA 4.0
curriculum.notStarted: Start it to create its deck and open its units.

generate.button: Write this unit with the AI
generate.status: Writing the unit with the AI. This takes a few seconds.
generate.incomplete: The AI did not return a usable unit.

word.allSorted: Every word of this unit is sorted.

edit.title: Edit the unit
edit.intro: Change what you want, then save. Nothing is written before you save, and only the parts you changed are sent.
edit.shadowWarning: Careful: if you change a line to shadow (its text, or which lines are ticked), the takes recorded for the old line stop counting. A completed unit can go back to “in progress”.
edit.libraryNote: A formula already in your library keeps its link only while its text stays the same.

shadowing.hint: Tick the lines you want to repeat aloud.

problems.shadowingWords: This line has {{words}} words; {{min}} to {{max}} are needed to shadow it.

edit.summary_one: The unit was not saved: {{count}} problem to fix.
edit.summary_other: The unit was not saved: {{count}} problems to fix.
edit.unlocated: Other problems found by the server:

stale.hint: The unit changed since you opened the editor (in another tab, for example). Your edits are still here: nothing was lost and nothing was saved.
stale.confirm: Replace your edits with the latest version of the unit?

formulas.add: Add these formulas to my library
formulas.added: Added: {{imported}} new, {{attached}} already in your library, {{skipped}} skipped.

dialogue.listenFirst: Listen first, then check the text.

shadowing.intro: Listen to a line, then repeat it aloud. A recording counts once it is transcribed: the speech recognition is not a pronunciation judge.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Everything here is computed from your logs: reviews, errors, productions and AI calls. Nothing is a counter kept on the side.
stats.demo: These are the figures of the fictional demo database.

insufficient.words_one: Not enough data ({{count}} word so far)
insufficient.words_other: Not enough data ({{count}} words so far)
insufficient.reviews_one: Not enough data ({{count}} review so far)
insufficient.reviews_other: Not enough data ({{count}} reviews so far)

chart.noPoints: No point to draw: every value of this period is missing or has too little data.

period.label: Period of the statistics
period.summary: From {{from}} to {{to}}, both days included. The headline figures and the trends below do not depend on this period.

problem.order: The start date must not be after the end date.
problem.tooLong: A period cannot be longer than {{max}} days.

export.hint: A zip with one CSV file per table, for your own analysis (for example in pandas).

errors.title: Errors
errors.intro: Errors per 100 words you produced, so that a day of heavy writing does not look like a regression.
errors.chartTitle: Errors per 100 words over the period
errors.chartNote: A period of fewer than 100 words has no point: with so few words a rate would mislead. Weekly grouping gives more points.
errors.unnormalized: Not in these rates: {{total}} errors with no word count to divide by (drills {{drill}}, typed confusions in reviews {{review}}, manual entries {{manual}}, other {{other}}).
errors.topEmpty: No recurring error in this period.
errors.trendsWindows: The last 28 days ({{bStart}} to {{bEnd}}) against the 28 before ({{aStart}} to {{aEnd}}), whatever the period above.
errors.fixedShare: Share of errors in categories that keep declining:
errors.thresholds: A category declines when its rate falls to {{declining}} of the earlier one or less, and rises from {{rising}}; in between it is stable.

memory.title: Memory
memory.intro: How well the cards hold: retention against your target, calibration of the scheduler, lapses and stability.
memory.retentionChart: Observed retention and target over the period
memory.retentionNote: Share of reviews of cards already in review that were not forgotten. A point needs at least 10 reviews.
memory.calibrationIntro: For each band of predicted recall, what really happened. The closer the two lines, the better the scheduler knows you.
memory.calibrationChart: Predicted and observed recall by band
memory.agreement: Ratings you changed after the automatic one:
memory.termGone: A term that no longer exists
memory.stabilityIntro: How long, in days, each card of a term being learned holds before it needs a review. Cards never reviewed are counted apart.
memory.consolidationTitle: Time before a term is consolidated
memory.consolidationEmpty: No term was consolidated in this period.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: Where your terms stand, how the library moved over the period, your decks and tracks, and the reviews coming.
progress.funnelIntro: The learning funnel, from the terms waiting in the queue to the ones you use actively.
progress.evolutionTitle: Terms by status over the period
progress.evolutionNote: Rebuilt from the event log at the end of each day or week, not read from a counter.
progress.evolutionChart: Number of terms by status at the end of each period
progress.forecastIntro: Cards due on each study day, starting today. Overdue cards count today.
progress.forecastChart: Cards due on each of the next 14 study days

practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: How much you worked, how regularly, and how much you wrote and said.
practice.studyNote: Counted from your actions only: a long reading without a click is not counted. The dashed line is the duration of the sessions, for comparison.
practice.studyChart: Study time in minutes over the period
practice.wordsNote: Your own words only: a pasted conversation counts your sentences, not the other speaker's.
practice.wordsChart: Words written and said over the period
practice.speechChart: Minutes of recorded speech over the period

ai.title: AI use
ai.intro: What the free tiers were asked, per provider. Only counts and durations: no key, no prompt and no answer is kept here.
ai.empty: No AI call in this period.
ai.tokensNote: Rate limits and used-up quotas are counted apart from the other errors. A provider that does not report its tokens shows 0.
ai.perDayNote: Always per day, whatever the grouping above.
ai.chart: AI requests per day and provider
ai.azureNote: The free tier of Azure has its own monthly limit: check it in the Azure portal.
